annotation.audio: A brief, upbeat instrumental music loop featuring a synthesized, bell-like arpeggiated melody, a simple bass line, and a basic drum machine beat.

annotation.cross_modal: The music plays continuously throughout the clip, and the text labels in the contact sheet indicate a frame-by-frame sequence (approximately 3 frames per second) across the three columns, left to right and top to bottom.

A three-column contact sheet of blue tiles with white timestamped text labels; no people, gestures, or actions are present.
